## One defect found and fixed — `11cbe8d`

**`input[type=checkbox]` and `[type=range]` had no keyboard focus indicator at all.**

`index.css:4392` stripped the outline from every `input`/`textarea`/`select` on `:focus-visible`. That's correct for text entry — `.form-input:focus` and `.topbar__search input:focus` substitute a border change plus a glow. But checkbox/radio/range are `appearance:none` custom chrome with no substitute, so the blanket rule left them with nothing. A keyboard-focused checkbox computed `outline:none`, `box-shadow:none` and the unchanged `--glass-border` — pixel-identical to its unfocused siblings. Reachable on `/leads`, where 26 row checkboxes including "Select all leads on this page" sit in the tab order.

The method that found it: the previous stage's `58c061f` fixed `.nav-link` and the calendar toolbar by beating an `outline: none !important` reset — the classic shape of a partial fix. So the axis to run was *"what else did that reset silence?"* Fixed additively, so text-input behavior is untouched; verified by real `Tab` (a programmatic `.focus()` doesn't match `:focus-visible` and would have produced a false pass).

## Three false positives dismissed

FullCalendar's square toolbar buttons are correct — `.fc-button-group` supplies the rounded outer edge via `overflow: hidden`. The hex colors are all outside the app's dark theme. The 50 textless `/subcontractors` buttons all carry `title=`.

## Worth your attention

Filter-tab active states (~8 treatments), modal titles (3 sizes plus an `<h3>` where others use `<h2>`), and the standing form-label finding (31 of 53 off-standard) share **one** root cause: every file hand-rolls an inline style object instead of sharing a class. Each is internally consistent within its own row, so nothing looks broken — but one convention decision would close all three. I left them alone rather than half-convert a multi-file convention, consistent with prior runs. `index.css:2239` already defines the label target.
